detail: *** THE CONTROL IS WHAT MATTERS HERE. *** A Brayley search for Devon 1795-1805 returned three results, none at Westleigh - Berrynarbor, Bampton and Whitchurch. *** That null is worthless, and checking why proved it: *** FreeREG holds *** 111 Devon parishes and WESTLEIGH, COLDRIDGE, BRAUNTON, BIDEFORD and SHIRWELL are not among them. *** Every parish the ascent runs through is missing except one.

tool: *** FreeREG, Northam *** - the one parish it does hold
detail: Northam is in the list, so a Taylor search was run: *** 0 results for 1865-1895. *** Control again: the same search over 1538-1950 returns *** 90 Taylor records, and they run 1655 to 1815 *** - baptisms 1677-1815, burials 1655-1813, marriages 1678-1815, and *** nothing at all after 1860. *** So the null is coverage, not absence. *** The Taylors arrive in Northam after FreeREG's transcription stops. ***
